ValidationRule.description: AFCA Response Due Date should be mandatory to complete while converting an EDR shell case that has origin IDR Referral.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(RecordTypeId))), OR( ISPICKVAL(Origin,'11'), ISPICKVAL(Origin,'Referred from AFCA') ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(IDR_AFCA_Status__c,'10'), ISPICKVAL(IDR_AFCA_Status__c,'IDR Referral') ), ISNULL(IDR_AFCA_Due_Date__c) )
